query: SELECT p.id, p.name, pv.id as vid, pv.name as vname, pv.retailPrice, pv.size, pv.color FROM products p LEFT JOIN productVariants pv ON pv.productId = p.id WHERE p.isActive = 1 ORDER BY p.id, pv.id LIMIT 50;
